subject: Lodestar renewal + capacity increase — MAP & legal acceptance matrix
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lodestar.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Li <sam.li@lodestar.com>
Date: 2028-07-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — Lodestar

Hi Lauren,

We’re approaching our renewal window and want to discuss a 2.5x capacity increase for Q4 (more inference units for a new personalization feature). Procurement asked that we consolidate term changes and legal redlines into a single "mutual action plan" (MAP) so signoff is cleaner on their side.

High level asks:
- Move to a 24-month term starting 2028-10-01
- Order form to reflect 2.5x capacity and new pricing tier (we can share the spreadsheet)
- Clarify data retention / log export for audit purposes (SOC 2 scope)
- A clear acceptance matrix listing signatories from Lodestar and Redwood for each document and exhibit

Procurement timeline: they want final paperwork to procurement by Aug 10 to hit an Aug signing window. Can you and legal confirm whether that timeline is realistic?

Thanks — looping procurement (procurement@lodestar.com) and Sam who is coordinating the SOW.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform, Lodestar Analytics

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lodestar.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — Lodestar

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can do the MAP approach; it helps procurement on our side too. Quick answers:

- Timeline: Aug 10 target is tight but doable if we lock scope this week and legal turns within 48 business hours (we’ll prioritize).
- Next steps: please upload the current order form + your spreadsheet of expected usage. I’ve cc’d Marissa (legal) and Karthik (contracts/ops) to start a redline pass.
- Deliverable: our goal is a single PDF MAP (with a short schedule of deadlines) + a redline MSA and clean counter for DocuSign.

I’m attaching our renewal checklist to align tasks and owners. Can procurement confirm the signatory names/emails for the acceptance matrix?

Thanks — I’ll follow up after we have the first redline.

— Lauren
Director, Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-renewal-checklist.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lodestar.com>
Date: 2028-07-24T08:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — Lodestar (initial legal notes)

Thanks Lauren / Elena — I reviewed Lodestar's current order form and MSA. Initial redline summary below (we'll produce a tracked-change doc):

Priority items:
- Term: we can accept 24 months but propose an early termination carveout tied to misuse or breaches; will add standard language and exception path.
- Pricing & capacity: will update Exhibit B to show the 2.5x tiers; need the usage spreadsheet to confirm invoice cadence.
- SLAs: propose keeping existing p50/p95 latency SLAs but add a cap on cumulative SLA credits (we suggest 3 months invoice cap) — flagging for commercial approval.
- Data retention: propose retention period of 90 days for raw logs, 13 months for aggregated telemetry; Lodestar can request exports with an audit window.
- Indemnity/insurance: small edits to align with Redwood's policy — will not increase material exposure.

Attachments we will push in the next message:
- lodestar-msa_v3_redline.docx (tracked changes)
- lodestar-orderform-exhibitB-diff.pdf (redline highlights)

Action items for Lodestar: procurement to provide the acceptance matrix (names + signature roles) and the final usage spreadsheet. If procurement can confirm by EOD Tuesday (7/26), we can hit the Aug 10 procurement handoff.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lodestar.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@lodestar.com
Date: 2028-07-26T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Lodestar paperwork — consolidated redline + next steps

Elena — attaching the consolidated redline bundle (lodestar-msa_v3_redline.docx) and a PDF extract of Exhibit B highlights. Summary of notable edits:

- Term & renewal: updated effective/renewal dates to align with 2028-10-01 start; added a 30-day mutual review window prior to auto-renewal.
- Acceptance matrix: added a template section (page 4) where Lodestar and Redwood list document-level signers (MSA, Order Form, Exhibit B, Data Addendum). Please populate names and the signing authority email addresses.
- DocuSign path: we propose Redwood as first signer (non-executive ops), then Lodestar procurement, then executive sign-off — this reduces back-and-forth for operational edits. If Lodestar prefers a different signer order, confirm and we’ll adapt.

Next steps:
1) Lodestar populates acceptance matrix and returns the usage spreadsheet (needed for Exhibit B numbers).
2) Redwood legal turns a clean counter once acceptance matrix is populated (target: 24 business hours).
3) DocuSign envelope prepared and routed when both sides confirm.

Attachments: lodestar-msa_v3_redline.docx; lodestar-orderform-exhibitB-diff.pdf

Thanks — looping procurement for visibility.

— Karthik
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lodestar.com>

Thanks Karthik / Marissa / Lauren — this looks good. Procurement confirms the signers and timeline below:

- Procurement lead (signature): procurement@lodestar.com (procurement manager)
- Legal review: Sam Li (sam.li@lodestar.com) — final sign-off authority after procurement route
- Target: procurement will return completed acceptance matrix and usage spreadsheet by 2028-08-02.

We agree to the proposed DocuSign path — please generate the clean counter and a one-page MAP (deliverable + deadline table) for us to attach to our procurement packet. Once we have the DocuSign envelope, Lodestar will prioritize signature the week of Aug 7.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — will send the spreadsheets by COB tomorrow.

Best,
Elena
